requests.title: Package release conditions: run every generated command, prove contracts against real data, reconcile requirements with owner decisions (PRC-01)
requests.question: Should the next successor requirements package (after v4.1.5) carry the three release conditions of docs/optimization/implementation-conventions/PROPOSED-REQUIREMENTS-CHANGES.md PRC-01 in its FREEZE.md, so that the owner does not approve a package until its independent review records: (1) every generated suite command, workflow, SDK setup step and deploy precondition executed on the pinned SDK in a clean checkout; (2) replay coverage of the pinned causa-data histories with 0 events without a case and a negative control; (3) a table of every owner decision naming a requirement with its amendment or waiver?
options: A: yes: the next successor package carries PRC-01 release conditions 1-3 in its FREEZE.md
B: conditions 1 and 3 only (no replay-coverage condition)
C: no; release conditions stay as they are
requests.recommendation: A. Each condition addresses a failure that recurred: MSB1008 and SDK setup shipped in frozen v4.1.2 (HF-028, HF-029, HF-047); 487 of 1,315 causa-data events were unrepresentable in frozen v4.1.4 (HF-068); clauses contradicting owner decisions stayed in frozen packages (HF-023, HF-036).
requests.rationale: CV-01, CV-11, CV-14 in docs/optimization/implementation-conventions/CONVENTION-CATALOG.json. Pre-competition cost only (about 90 + 60 + 30 min per package); nothing is added inside the timed run.
requests.impact: Applies from the next successor package; v4.1.5 (CANDIDATE) and every frozen package are unchanged. The agent writes the FREEZE.md text into that successor package when it is compiled.

requests.title: Pin Forma 0.13.0 (PRC-02, breaking)
requests.question: Should the next successor package require Forma 0.13.0 (@echelon-foundry/design-system 0.13.0, inventory verification/design-contract/forma-0.13.0-inventory.json) in place of the 0.12.0 inventory, with CK-04 refusing an earlier Forma at bootstrap, as docs/optimization/implementation-conventions/PROPOSED-REQUIREMENTS-CHANGES.md PRC-02 states?
options: A: yes: pin Forma 0.13.0 in the next successor package and ask Conditor to install 0.13.0 in the indy-init preset
B: no; keep 0.12.0 (ODR-R10-05 continues to allow 0.12.x or 0.13.x)
requests.recommendation: A. Forma 0.12.0 fails 48 of 78 containment checks and 0.13.0 passes 78 of 78 (HF-080); the layout contract must be re-checked against 0.13.0.
requests.impact: Breaking dependency change: re-baselines the layout contract and needs a Conditor preset change.

requests.title: Bootstrap runs tools/conventions/conventions.fsx check (PRC-03)
requests.question: Should the next successor package's AGENT-RULES §1 (T10 bootstrap) run `dotnet fsi <indy-init>/tools/conventions/conventions.fsx -- check --workspace .` after `conditor ci-policy check`, with a finding stopping the bootstrap commit as a ci-policy finding does, as docs/optimization/implementation-conventions/PROPOSED-REQUIREMENTS-CHANGES.md PRC-03 states?
options: A: yes: run all four checks (CK-01 warnings-as-errors, CK-02 one source per port literal, CK-03 workflow shell with pipefail, CK-04 Forma version) at bootstrap
B: yes, but CK-01..CK-03 only (CK-04 waits for ODR-IC-02)
requests.recommendation: A if ODR-IC-02 is A; otherwise B, because the current Conditor scaffold pins Forma 0.12.0 and CK-04 would stop the bootstrap.
requests.rationale: CV-05, CV-07, CV-10, CV-17. Runs in under 1 s. Retrospectively it finds 23 (R8) and 39 (R9) workflow steps without pipefail, a duplicated port in R9 and the preview app, and Forma below 0.13.0 in R8, the preview app and the Conditor 0.10.18 scaffold.
requests.impact: Applies from the next successor package. Not added to protected CI and not run on every merge; no frozen package changes.
